purpose: Test whether P02's full-vocabulary frozen-lens projected readout generalizes beyond its twelve controlled public rows before testing a compact scorer.

dual_benchmark_protocol.role: context_only; this exploratory panel does not add an active method or canonical cell

scope_boundaries: Stage 1 is a broader stratified public natural diagnostic, not a universal public-source representativeness claim, canonical benchmark replacement, or overall-best claim.
The historical affine lens and projected prototypes retain their fitted public Alpaca provenance; no fitting-free claim is made.
P02 controlled cases are excluded by exact BOS-anchored prefix tuple identity only. Their token IDs are not globally excluded.
Stage 2 is limited to the predeclared ranks 128 and 256 with no adaptive rank, threshold, decomposition, or rescue sweep.

process_separation.current_incident: Source task 01a071d9-7943-7301-9eaa-1bff9e7d4d50 accidentally sent P03 panel/interface planning to independent TRR-0004 during setup.
process_separation.disclosure: The message contained no records, source truth, scores, or private data.
process_separation.receiver_response: The receiving task reported that its methods and fresh records were already frozen and that it would not use the message for its own work or this task's next decision.
process_separation.routing: Only root task 01a07061-9c25-7e13-bcac-12d57c41c666 receives P03 scientific messages.
process_separation.use_rule: P03 uses no scientific output from the misrouted message or TRR-0004 and verifies that unrelated-task content cannot enter observation generation, method choice, scoring, or interpretation.

shifted_full_sft.lineage: verified full-SFT derivative of the pinned Meta Llama checkpoint
shifted_full_sft.resource_rule: an unavailable compute window delays this arm; it does not authorize dropping the condition or weakening the Stage 1 gate

historical_affine_lens.role: frozen public Alpaca fitted comparator and projection map
historical_affine_lens.fitting_provenance: public Alpaca only; no target or evaluation truth; no new fitting in TRR-P03
historical_affine_lens.map: g(h)=W h + a; query and candidate normalization is float32

p02_exact_tuple_exclusion.rule: reject any candidate whose BOS-anchored early scored prefix through an endpoint exactly equals a listed P02 sequence/context/endpoint tuple; do not reject token IDs globally
p02_exact_tuple_exclusion.note: Longer natural prompts can contain a P02 tuple in their early scored positions, so the prefix collision filter is applied after each declared truncation/window.

prior_overlap_audit.rule: audit exact prompt_id, prompt hash, and selected token-window overlap against previously opened panels before observation freeze; exclude only exact overlapping records
prior_overlap_audit.dataset_reason: the new no_robots dataset is distinct from P01's Pile source, but the audit is retained and recorded rather than assumed

dataset.prompt_policy: use natural dataset prompts as supplied; no generated or semantically rewritten text; for a declared length window, prepend BOS and retain the first requested tokenizer tokens without added specials

style_metadata.source: dataset category metadata; exact category-to-style mapping is frozen here and copied to the selector receipt

stage1.record_order: length-major, then style-major with two records per style as listed above
stage1.selection: scan the seeded public permutation for the first unused row matching the requested category-derived style and minimum token length, excluding exact overlap and BOS-anchored P02 prefix collisions; fail closed if any slot cannot be filled
stage1.target_observation_contract: the selected source sequence, order, valid length, mask, and positions are identical across matched_public and shifted_full_sft; only target weights change

stage2_holdout.selection: same length/style slots and exact-overlap rules as Stage 1, independent seed 20260907, excluding every Stage 1 row
stage2_holdout.truth_status: holdout truth and observations may be prepared and hashed before Stage 1 scoring, but holdout truth remains unopened and unscored until Stage 1 disposition and Stage 2 compact-method freeze
stage2_holdout.use: only if the Stage 1 gate advances

a1_a2_anchor.selection_definition: length-39 Stage 1 records at zero-based stratum indices [0, 2, 4, 5], fixed before truth and observations
a1_a2_anchor.ids_are_resolved_by: the deterministic stage-local selector; these opaque IDs are fixed by the declared ordering before truth and observations
a1_a2_anchor.purpose: retain a modest A1+A2 accuracy/cost target without reshaping its native 40-slot policy
a1_a2_anchor.gate_role: anchor only; never used to promote a projected readout

raw_boundary_full_vocab.query: h at each active post-BOS position
raw_boundary_full_vocab.candidate: b_v for v=0..128255 from the read-only boundary table

projected_frozen_lens_full_vocab.candidate: normalize_fp32(g(b_v)) for v=0..128255, streamed or persisted once
projected_frozen_lens_full_vocab.fitted_origin: historical public Alpaca affine lens; fitted comparator

historical_native_a1_full_vocab.score: native FP32 FrozenAffineLens exp(s)-scaled cosine logits from g(h) against E_v; use these logits for top-1 decisions, then optionally divide by exp(s) for cosine-equivalent reporting
historical_native_a1_full_vocab.fitted_origin: historical public Alpaca affine lens; fitted comparator
historical_native_a1_full_vocab.comparison_role: primary comparator for projected full-vocabulary readout

historical_native_a1_a2_40slot_anchor.scope: four predeclared length-39 records under each required target condition
historical_native_a1_a2_40slot_anchor.rule: published fixed K=256 historical A1 proposals, direct public-prefix cosine for each candidate, no immediate A1 shortcut, adaptivity, gate, centering, or abstention, always commit
historical_native_a1_a2_40slot_anchor.geometry: exact 40 slots including BOS and 39 scored positions; no reshape
historical_native_a1_a2_40slot_anchor.fitted_origin: historical public Alpaca A1 and public-prefix A2; fitted comparator only
historical_native_a1_a2_40slot_anchor.tie_policy: preserve native torch.topk candidate ordering and first-argmax tie behavior

tie_policy.standalone_full_vocab: float32 score descending then smallest token ID ascending; use this deterministic order for raw, projected, and standalone historical A1 top-1
tie_policy.strict_rank: 1 + count(score > true_score); equal-score count is retained separately and is not silently scored as a win
tie_policy.native_a1_scale: native FP32 logits retain positive exp(s) for decisions; divide by exp(s) only for reporting after decisions, and do not infer finite-precision tie equivalence from rescaling
tie_policy.native_a1_a2: published torch.topk/native-order and first-argmax ties are preserved and reported separately; do not silently unify with standalone ID-ascending ties
tie_policy.nonfinite: fail closed on any nonfinite query, candidate, or score

observation_and_freeze.evaluator: source-aware target builder is separate and may use source sequences to generate observations and private truth
observation_and_freeze.representation: right-pad only for batch transport; masks and positions identify valid slots; all methods see identical observation bytes within a condition
freeze_order: freeze plan, method source/configuration, asset hashes, selection, and target-condition map
generate and hash both matched and shifted target observation bundles
run raw, projected, historical A1, and the four-record A1+A2 anchor for both conditions
freeze and hash-validate every per-condition/per-method receipt and the complete matrix before any Stage 1 truth is opened or scored
open truth once and score only the immutable predictions
observation_and_freeze.truth_after_freeze: truth cannot revise predictions, candidate sets, routes, timing, thresholds, state, or method selection
observation_and_freeze.stage2_holdout: holdout truth is opened only after a passing Stage 1 gate and after ranks, factorization, quality target, and footprint target are frozen

required.token_accuracy: correct post-BOS predictions divided by 1482 valid positions per target condition
required.exact_records: count/rate with every valid post-BOS token correct; BOS is not scored
required.paired_changes: projected-minus-A1 token delta and exact-record delta on identical record IDs
required.gain_loss: record counts with projected correct-token count greater than, equal to, or less than A1; report median and worst record-level losses descriptively
required.deterministic_predictions: top-1 IDs, selected scores when available, ties, and tie-policy IDs

metrics.no_pooling: matched and shifted conditions, natural Stage 1, P02 controls, prior opened panels, and the A1+A2 anchor remain separate

uncertainty.method: paired record-cluster percentile bootstrap stratified by post-BOS length
uncertainty.sampling: sample six records with replacement independently within each of four length strata and reuse the sampled records for projected and A1
uncertainty.primary_statistic: micro token-accuracy difference over the sampled record multiset
uncertainty.report: point estimate, CI, per-length estimates, and record gain/tie/loss counts; exact-record CI is descriptive and not an additional gate
uncertainty.unit: tokens are not treated as independent bootstrap units

stage1_gate.name: representative_projected_readout_gate
stage1_gate.comparison: projected_frozen_lens_full_vocab versus historical_native_a1_full_vocab on identical Stage 1 observations

matched_public.cluster_ci_condition: lower endpoint of the 95% length-stratified paired record-cluster CI > 0
matched_public.exact_condition: projected exact-record count >= A1 exact-record count

shifted_full_sft.exact_condition: projected exact-record count >= A1 exact-record count
shifted_full_sft.ci_role: report the same bootstrap CI; the nonnegative point and nonlower exact-record conditions are the continuation checks

stage1_gate.advance: all matched and shifted conditions pass their predeclared checks
stage1_gate.stop_clear_regression: matched point estimate is at least 1 pp below A1, or its CI is wholly below zero with fewer projected exact records; an available shifted condition regression also stops
stage1_gate.stop_no_representative_advantage: any other gate failure, including a small positive gain or an interval spanning zero; no Stage 2 truth is opened
stage1_gate.interpretation: These are bounded exploratory decisions, not universal claims. P02's 11/12 versus 9/12 controlled-row difference cannot bypass this gate, and a failure does not prove that all no-fit methods or all compression mechanisms fail.

methods.projected_compact: rank-r approximation of normalized projected candidate matrix
methods.a1_compact_control: same-rank approximation of normalized public input-embedding candidate matrix with identical factor precision, score kernel, and query count

decomposition.algorithm: deterministic float32 randomized range finder, oversampling 16, two power iterations, fixed seed 8675309, QR, and small SVD
decomposition.factorization: C approximately U_r Sigma_r V_r^T; persist A=U_r Sigma_r, B=V_r, and row norms ||A[v,:]||
decomposition.bias: the affine bias remains in g(h) and g(b_v) before normalization
decomposition.freeze: ranks, seed, oversampling, iterations, precision, and tie rule are fixed before holdout truth; no failed rank may trigger a rescue

quality_target.same_budget_control: report compact projected-minus-compact A1 token and exact-record deltas at each rank

practical_target.accounting: report full candidate/parent assets, factor bytes, lens/query assets, construction workspace, deployed resident storage, model memory, scratch, and I/O separately

outcomes.compact_success: quality, storage, and runtime targets pass
outcomes.quality_retained_without_runtime_benefit: quality and storage pass but runtime reduction is below 20%; footprint-only diagnostic
outcomes.quality_failure: accuracy loss exceeds 1 pp or exact-record loss exceeds 1; reject the tested rank and run no rescue
outcomes.not_run: Stage 1 gate or resource preflight fails; holdout truth remains unopened

stage2.scope: Any success is a fitted-origin, A2-free scorer diagnostic and does not remove historical fitting, establish a canonical replacement, or settle no-fit research.

guards.qualification: qualify the length-128 observation/readout and largest full-vocabulary lookup before the matrix

resource_preflight.equivalence: a batch-size or numerical workaround requires exact output and prediction equivalence on a fixed public fixture; differing attempts are retained and excluded
resource_preflight.no_heavy_pre_gate: do not run Stage 2 decomposition or holdout scoring before Stage 1 gate review

evidence.publication_order: publish the complete uncompressed Stage 1 finding and gate disposition before optional Stage 2 holdout truth is opened
